sentences.text: 51 Of Food Safety And Standard Act vs In Re : Kaushar Ali Dhali

on 18 September, 2018  1 19.09.2018 sdas Rejected C.R.M. 7827 of 2018 In Re.: An application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure filed on 13.09.2018 in connection with Airport Police Station Case No. 78 of 2018 dated 27.04.2018 under Sections 272/273 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 51 of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.

entities.text: Airport Police Station Case No. 78 of 2018
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
And In Re : Kaushar Ali Dhali ..... petitioner Mr. Nazmul Alom Sarkar ... for the petitioner Mr.
Ranabir Roy Chowdhury, Mr. Mainak Gupta ... for the State Learned Counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is in custody for 118 days and it is also submitted that the sample of food item seized from the possession of the petitioner was not analyzed properly.
Learned Counsel appearing for the State opposes the prayer for bail and submits that the petitioner is the principal offender who was selling rotten meat which is harmful for public consumption.
We have considered the materials on record and we find that there is ample evidence on record to show that the food item which was seized was deleterious to human consumption and endangered life.
In view of the gravity of the offence and the prima facie involvement of the petitioner therein, we are not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner at this stage.
The application for bail is, thus, rejected.

(Ravi Krishan Kapur, J.) (Joymalya Bagchi, J.) C.R.M. 192 of 2018 In Re.: An application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure filed on 05.01.2018 in connection with Karimpur Police Station Case No. 136 of 2012 dated 03.07.2012 under Sections 420/467/468/471/120B of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: Karimpur Police Station Case No. 136 of 2012
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: And In Re : Rabish Kumar Upadhyay ..... petitioner Mr. Asraf Ali ... for the petitioner Mr. Debojyoti Deb ... for the State

Having considered the materials on record prima facie disclosing involvement of the petitioner in the alleged crime of misappropriation of monies of the innocent depositors and the fact that the petitioner has absconded for a protracted period of time, we are not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner at this stage.
The application for bail is, thus, rejected.

(Rajarshi Bharadwaj, J.) (Joymalya Bagchi, J.)
